definition.endpoints: 21 economic closes and 20 paired known positive volumes through t; target=max(0,100*(1-min(C[t+1:t+21])/C[t+1]))
definition.direction: Positive: volume more biased toward upward than simple day-count direction; no preset risk or trading implication
definition.transforms: Economic close action-adjusted; nominal same-ETF volume weights within uninterrupted unit window; no normalization or epsilon. Known split begins new volume window.

lifecycle.verification_scope: Independent arithmetic and boundary tests verified; source qualification and predictive effects separate
